about: The postcommunio of the formulary “16th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, we beseech You, graciously cleanse and renew our minds with the heavenly sacrament, so we may thereby also receive bodily help for the present as well as for the future. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
